body:
## Architecture Finding

**Type**: coupling / tech-debt (duplicated ownership across repositories)
**Affected area**: `scripts/lib-install-qemu.sh`, `scripts/plain-install-qemu.sh`, `scripts/luks-install-qemu.sh`, `scripts/fisherman-install.sh`, `tromso/src/luks-unlock.py`, `tromso/src/show-screenshot.sh`, `scripts/cas-restore-stream.sh`, `scripts/ghcr-blob-stream.py`, `scripts/embed-oci-payload.sh`

Tromso and `tuna-os/brussels` each carry their own copy of the same image-agnostic ISO / end-to-end install toolchain. Neither copy is the owner; fixes move between them by hand (tromso#312 "ideas worth taking from the sibling image repos", `embed-oci-payload.sh` header "approach follows tromso#406 and brussels#264").

Measured against `tuna-os/brussels` @ `main` on 2026-11-13 (`diff` changed-line counts):

| tromso path | brussels path | state |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/ghcr-blob-stream.py` | `scripts/ghcr-blob-stream.py` | identical |
| `tromso/src/show-screenshot.sh` | `xfce-linux/src/show-screenshot.sh` | identical |
| `scripts/cas-restore-stream.sh` | same | 9 lines — tromso-only `--exclude=sources` fix for the build_final disk exhaustion in run 33295159787 |
| `tromso/src/luks-unlock.py` | `xfce-linux/src/luks-unlock.py` | 17 lines — tromso adds SDDM marker |
| `scripts/embed-oci-payload.sh` | same | 21 lines — tromso-only rewrite of recipe/catalog imgref to the digest-pinned candidate |
| `scripts/luks-install-qemu.sh` | same | 55 lines |
| `scripts/plain-install-qemu.sh` | same | 65 lines |
| `scripts/fisherman-install.sh` | same | 79 lines |
| `scripts/lib-install-qemu.sh` | same | 184 lines — **different function API** (`install_qemu_init`/`install_qemu_run_fisherman` here vs `lib_resolve_install_image` there) |

Most differences are not image-specific (KDE vs Xfce). They are fixes and refactors that landed on one side only. Example: the build_final CAS reader. bst-ci's own restore (`multirunner-build.yml`) excludes `./sources ./logs ./cas/staging ./cas/tmp *.sock`. Tromso's copy excludes only `sources`, and brussels' copy excludes nothing. That gives three extract filters for one archive format, which bst-ci produces (see tuna-os/bst-ci#59).

## Impact

- A fix made in one image repo silently stays missing from the other. Brussels' build_final still extracts every chunk's `sources/` tree, which is the failure tromso already fixed.
- `lib-install-qemu.sh` has forked into two incompatible APIs, so a later port is a rewrite, not a cherry-pick.
- Each BuildStream image added to the org (the pattern is already dakota → xfce-linux → tromso) makes another fork.
- The bst-ci archive format (tar.zst of `~/.cache/buildstream`, media type `application/vnd.buildstream.cas.tar.zst`) has readers outside the repository that versions it. A producer change cannot be tested against them.

## Recommendation

Give the image-agnostic tooling one owner: `tuna-os/bst-ci`. Both repos already consume it, pinned by SHA (`multirunner-build.yml@440509b5…`), and its `scripts/ci-build-matrix.py` is already checked out at run time by consumers. Move the toolchain there behind its existing pin. Parameterise only the image-specific inputs, which are few: display-manager marker, receipt `kind`, image name. Tromso then deletes its copies and calls the pinned versions.

Order:
1. CAS reader (`cas-restore-stream.sh` + `ghcr-blob-stream.py`). This is the restore half of the transport interface proposed in tuna-os/bst-ci#59. Land it with that issue so producer and reader share one version.
2. QEMU e2e install harness (`lib-install-qemu.sh`, plain/LUKS wrappers, `fisherman-install.sh`, `luks-unlock.py`, `show-screenshot.sh`). Before moving it, reconcile the two `lib-install-qemu.sh` APIs into one.
3. `embed-oci-payload.sh`, parameterised by receipt `kind`.

Decision taken by hive: bst-ci is the home. It is already a SHA-pinned dependency of both consumers, so this adds no new repository or trust edge. Brussels needs the same consumer-side change; this issue tracks tromso's side.

- [ ] tromso build_final restores CAS through the bst-ci-owned reader; local `scripts/cas-restore-stream.sh` and `scripts/ghcr-blob-stream.py` removed
- [ ] tromso e2e jobs use the bst-ci-owned install harness; local copies removed
- [ ] `embed-oci-payload.sh` consumed from bst-ci
